notes:
Written by am-06-x from three pages (budget 2-5). Not settled:
(1) The page gives no area and no boundaries. The starting 1513 claim and Luna's 1559 colony are not drawn; Santa Elena (founded 1566, first capital) has no end on the page and is not drawn. The missions of Guale, Timucua and Apalachee are drawn as the whole of the gazetteer's Florida (which includes south Florida, never Spanish) from 1630 to 1705.
(2) The northern limit of Spanish West Florida: the page gives only the 31st parallel (1795); the earlier Spanish claim (north of it) and the Natchez district are not on the page and not drawn. The 1783-1795 and 1810 events use a band polygon and 'West Florida without Mobile and Pensacola' as stand-ins; a gap-filler with the West Florida and Republic of West Florida pages should replace them.
(3) Dates differ: the Adams-Onis page says the treaty was effective 22 February 1821 and the Spanish Florida page says 17 July 1821 (used); the lead dates Pensacola to 1698 and the body to 1696 (1696 used); Georgia is 1732 on this page. The Spanish Florida page gives no Galvez campaign: the Louisiana page is cited for it. British East and West Florida (1763-1783) have no Cliopatria row and no dossier; they are the gap between keyframes.
(4) Counterparts: 'french-florida' (Fort Caroline, 1564-1565) is a name only (also suggested by am-06-c); 'english-colonial-empire' stands for Carolina (the page names Moore's army). Gazetteer: the region names resolved.
